hypothesisDisposition.scope: Six escaped spellings versus one literal timestamp on four hosted native targets
hypothesisDisposition.conclusion: A direct Time.UnmarshalJSON call is not a reliable proxy for this applications typed JSON codec. All observed application/codec cases accept the equivalent string and preserve its instant; no production rewrite is justified.

failedPreparationAttempts.reason: Collector expected a complete Output line; pinned Go test2json uses1024byte output chunks. Source-corrected collector adds bounded reassembly and a fragmented-wire regression. Superseding push cancelled unfinished redundant browser jobs.

changedContracts: Application acceptance of literal and six escaped timestamp spellings is mandatory; fixed observations distinguish codec results from the direct SDK method.
Typed timestamps in direct/pointer/slice/map positions preserve the same instant and null semantics while a signature-covered RawMessage retains exact bytes.
Accepted-input fuzzing checks opaque payload byte retention and adds two escaped timestamp seeds without changing production parser behavior.

The hosted-only observation collector retains fixed IDs, booleans, closed causes, source hashes and SDK identity; it rejects local execution, unknown fields, over-limit/truncated fragments, overwritten reports and redirected destinations.
limits: Finite spellings and thirty-second fuzzing do not prove exhaustive encoding behavior, long-duration stability or other compiler/configuration variants.
Native execution is Windows/Linux AMD64/ARM64; the remaining six desktop targets are compile-only in this checkpoint.
Fixture Ed25519 signatures prove opaque payload byte retention, not publisher authentication or signed installed-product readiness.
Browser acceptance uses the unchanged source-built Linux52case/256profile/25cap workload; native assistive technology and managed endpoint acceptance remain separate.
The observation collector owns only its Go root command for emergency timeout; arbitrary descendant cleanup is not qualified.
Signing identity, held Mac launch-preparation diagnostics, private-output architecture selection and all broader fifty-gate requirements remain open.
